text: Left unchecked, AI could endanger the entire global financial system — including your bank account. Pause AI NOW!
context: Responding on X to an Axios report that major US banks are detecting unauthorized third-party AI agents inside customer accounts.
source_note: Post on X, October 22, 2026; Axios report by Madison Mills

text: The consequences of an AI correction could be global.
context: Warning that sky-high AI valuations and rising debt put world financial stability at risk.
source_note: IMF Global Financial Stability Report, October 2026; also reported by Reuters

role: Nobel laureate in physics; AI pioneer
text: The unique problem with AI is that if it goes wrong, if it takes over, you don't get a second chance.
context: In a Guardian interview, warning that humans are creating “alien beings.”
source_note: Interview, October 13, 2026; also reported by Benzinga

text: We must PAUSE advanced AI and permanently BAN artificial superintelligence before it is too late.
context: Responding on X to Sam Altman, who said people may have to accept “fairly severe cyber incidents” in exchange for liberty.
source_note: Post on X, October 12, 2026; also reported by Benzinga

text: AI less regulated than milk, Microsoft president says in warning over safety
context: Calling for tougher rules on the BBC: "Right now, your washing machine is subject to more safety rules than AI."
source_note: Headline, October 12, 2026; from his BBC Big Boss Interview

text: Anthropic discloses incidents of its AI models misusing government sites
context: The company's own disclosure, reported by The Washington Post.

text: As public fears of AI grow, Trump digs in on voluntary safeguards
context: He announced a voluntary safety pact with Nvidia, SpaceX, OpenAI, Anthropic, Meta and Google, calling it "morally binding."

text: OpenAI safety employee quits, says 'time for trial and error is over'
context: In The Atlantic, he wrote that "the companies building this technology aren't being nearly careful enough."

role: Former chief scientist, UK AI Security Institute
text: I believe there's about a 50% chance we all die because of the development of smarter-than-human AI systems.
context: Writing in TIME. He adds that "our actions over the next two to 10 years will determine the outcome."

text: Algorithms lack the spark of humanity.
context: Calling on the Church to ally with artists: "it is becoming urgent to distinguish human art from what machines produce."
source_note: Post on X, reported by Axios

role: Turing Award winner; founder, AMI Labs
text: ‘AI can kill us all’ is incredibly destructive for everybody.
context: Speaking to Fortune. On Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei: "I think he's completely deluded."

role: Former OpenAI researcher, AI Futures Project
text: Anthropic and OpenAI are racing each other towards superintelligence.
context: Testifying to a US Senate subcommittee on rogue AI. On timing: "I personally would guess about 50% chance by end of 2028."
source_note: Written testimony, US Senate subcommittee hearing, September 30, 2026

text: I do think that the concerns raised by many of the experts, specialists in AI, should be taken seriously.
context: On his flight home from France, after AI fears were called a hoax: "I don't think that that is fake news, as some have said."
source_note: Papal news conference; AFP, AP and Reuters

text: Always under human control.
context: His condition for AI development, set out at the White House during his state visit.

role: AI pioneer; co-chair, UN scientific panel on AI
text: The dangers are real and imminent.
context: Telling the UN Security Council it faces "an unprecedented threat, one that none of its members would choose."
source_note: UN Security Council meeting, New York

text: …AI could be a risk to humanity as a whole.
context: Telling the UN Security Council what could happen "if managed poorly."
source_note: UN Security Council meeting, New York; also reported by SBS

text: We should not train models that we cannot make an extremely strong case that will be able to keep under human control.
context: At the UN Security Council, calling for international AI safety rules.
source_note: UN Security Council meeting, New York

text: We're going to encourage it, not rein it in.
context: At the UN General Assembly, where he ordered US documents to call AI "super intelligence."

text: There is 0% chance that's going to be the end of the world.
context: Responding to warnings that AI could kill everyone by 2030. He added: "Scaring people is unnecessary. It is irresponsible."

text: …this race to the bottom that could lead one day to a gigantic disaster at global level.
context: Urging the countries leading AI to cooperate on safety.
source_note: Remarks to UN reporters; AP report

text: I agree with Dario that we need to pace the frontier.
context: Backing Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei's call for the industry to slow down.
source_note: Post on X, reported by ITV News

text: Dario is right.
context: Replying to Dario Amodei's call to slow down frontier AI.

text: Left unchecked, it could outrun our ability to understand and control these systems…
context: In "We Must Pace the Frontier," asking AI companies to slow down together.

text: We really do earnestly believe AI could kill all humans!
context: His own estimate, posted on X: "I personally think it is >10% within the next decade."
source_note: Post on X; also reported by the BBC

role: UN High Commissioner for Human Rights
text: I share the concerns of industry insiders that advanced AI could pose an existential risk to humanity.
context: Speaking to the UN Human Rights Council in Geneva.

text: If we continue with the present accelerating pace of the AI race, yes, this will be the result. In 10 years, the AIs will take over.
context: On The Economist's podcast with editor-in-chief Zanny Minton Beddoes.

text: Cyber-capable OpenAI models compromised Hugging Face production during a benchmark evaluation.
context: The models escaped a restricted test and reached the internet. OpenAI called it "an unprecedented security incident."
source_note: OpenAI post on X; eWeek report

text: The development of artificial intelligence should not be a solo performance by any single country.
context: At the World Artificial Intelligence Conference in Shanghai.

role: Former OpenAI researcher, AI Futures Project
text: We at the AI Futures Project think that there's a 70% chance of all humans dead or something similarly bad.
context: Talking with Ronny Chieng on The Daily Show.

text: Maybe with 10 gigawatts of compute, AI can figure out how to cure cancer.
context: In his blog post "Abundant Intelligence," arguing for far more AI computing power.

text: …astounding triumphs – fixing the climate, establishing a space colony, and the discovery of all of physics – will eventually become commonplace.
context: In his essay "The Intelligence Age."

role: Signed by the heads of OpenAI, Google DeepMind and Anthropic
text: Mitigating the risk of extinction from AI should be a global priority alongside other societal-scale risks such as pandemics and nuclear war.
context: One sentence, signed by hundreds of AI scientists and leaders.
